featured_reviews.name: Hitesh Dantani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beware of overcharging at this DTC Courier branch!
I visited this branch to send a small parcel to Ahmedabad. The lady at the counter quoted ₹700–₹800, which seemed too high. I showed her the official DTC online app where the rate for the same parcel was around ₹300–₹500. Shockingly, she claimed the app was fake and insisted on her inflated price.

This feels like a scam. I ended up using a local courier service instead—they were polite, helpful, and charged just ₹250 for the same shipment. Much better experience!

I do not recommend this DTC branch. Please cross-check prices online before using their service. There are better and cheaper options available locally
